# NotchKit

> NotchKit turns the MacBook notch into an interactive Dynamic Island in SwiftUI. An island rests as a pill against the screen edge and morphs open on hover or click — one shape whose width, height, and corner radii animate together, rather than two views cross-fading into each other.

NotchKit owns the window, silhouette, hit testing, pointer hysteresis, and motion. You write two SwiftUI views: what the collapsed pill shows and what the expanded panel shows.

## Core Documentation

- [Getting Started](https://github.com/duongductrong/NotchKit/blob/master/docs/getting-started.md): Installation via SPM, accessory app setup (`LSUIElement`), first island setup, and verification checklist.
- [Customization Guide](https://github.com/duongductrong/NotchKit/blob/master/docs/customization.md): Complete reference for `NotchConfiguration`, `NotchMotion`, `NotchStyle`, `NotchCollapsedWidth`, `NotchExpandedTopReserve`, and `NotchBarsStyle`.
- [Architecture & Geometry](https://github.com/duongductrong/NotchKit/blob/master/docs/architecture.md): Coordinate spaces, pure geometry functions, window positioning, hit-testing mechanics, and multi-display handling.
- [Motion System](https://github.com/duongductrong/NotchKit/blob/master/docs/motion.md): Spring parameters, phase curves, hover hysteresis, and Reduce Motion accessibility support.
- [Recipes & Use Cases](https://github.com/duongductrong/NotchKit/blob/master/docs/recipes.md): Code examples for notification islands, media controllers with equalizers, progress trackers, hotkey toggles, and multi-display setups.
- [Morph Mechanics](https://github.com/duongductrong/NotchKit/blob/master/docs/morph-section.md): Detailed mechanics of single-shape morphing without view cross-fading.
- [Troubleshooting](https://github.com/duongductrong/NotchKit/blob/master/docs/troubleshooting.md): Diagnosis and fixes for common notch rendering, window ordering, and event handling issues.

## Primary APIs

- `NotchPresenter`: Main actor controller that installs, drives (`expand()`, `collapse()`, `toggle()`, `peek()`), and configures the island window.
- `NotchCutoutLayout`: Collapsed pill container that reserves physical cutout space and provides leading and trailing content slots.
- `NotchConfiguration`: Value type configuring expanded size, collapsed width policy (`.wrapCutout`, `.fixed`), top reserve policy (`.cutoutOnly`, `.always`, `.fixed`, `.none`), content alignment, and corner radii.
- `NotchMotion`: Value type defining spring curves, scale multipliers, hover delays, and phase timings (honors `.resolved` for Reduce Motion).
- `NotchStyle`: Visual styling specifying background ink, hairline border, shadow, and color scheme (supports light/dark island rendering).
- `NotchBars` / `NotchBarsStyle`: Audio equalizer and status indicator component supporting `.wave` and `.steady` preset styles.

## Runnable Examples

- [NotchDemo App](https://github.com/duongductrong/NotchKit/tree/master/Examples/NotchDemo): Runnable macOS demo app (`swift run NotchDemo`) showcasing three distinct island presets:
  - `VibeCode` ([`VibeCodeIsland.swift`](https://github.com/duongductrong/NotchKit/blob/master/Examples/NotchDemo/VibeCodeIsland.swift)): AI coding agent interface with interactive permission prompt cards, task list, and walking pixel cat indicator.
  - `NowPlaying` ([`NowPlayingIsland.swift`](https://github.com/duongductrong/NotchKit/blob/master/Examples/NotchDemo/NowPlayingIsland.swift)): Native macOS Apple Music style player with album art, scrubber, and transport controls.
  - `MorphInspector` ([`MorphInspectorIsland.swift`](https://github.com/duongductrong/NotchKit/blob/master/Examples/NotchDemo/MorphInspectorIsland.swift)): Interactive geometry morphing silhouette inspector.

## Package Installation

Declare in `Package.swift`:

```swift
dependencies: [
    .package(url: "https://github.com/duongductrong/NotchKit.git", from: "1.2.1")
],
targets: [
    .target(name: "YourApp", dependencies: ["NotchKit"])
]
```

## Quick Start Example

```swift
import AppKit
import SwiftUI
import NotchKit

@MainActor
final class AppDelegate: NSObject, NSApplicationDelegate {
    private var presenter: NotchPresenter?

    func applicationDidFinishLaunching(_ note: Notification) {
        let presenter = NotchPresenter()
        self.presenter = presenter

        presenter.install(
            collapsed: {
                NotchCutoutLayout(
                    cutoutWidth: presenter.geometry.hasPhysicalNotch ? presenter.geometry.notchWidth : 0,
                    gutterWidth: presenter.collapsedGutterWidth,
                    pillHeight: presenter.geometry.collapsedHeight
                ) {
                    Image(systemName: "sparkles")
                } trailing: {
                    Text("3").monospacedDigit()
                }
            },
            expanded: {
                VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 8) {
                    Text("Panel Title").font(.headline)
                    Text("Panel content goes here").font(.subheadline)
                }
            }
        )
    }
}
```
